lines.en: Since the dawn of time, human beings have striven for one thing and one thing only — a place where all is bright and beautiful. And in the 1970’s, we finally found it.
What I’m speaking of is, of course, the maid cafe. Which, believe it or not, was actually first conceived in the US.
And it would remain there for roughly three decades until Japan finally got its hands on it and turned it into the ever-growing empire it is to this day.
Tonight, that’s where I’ll be going. But it’s not just because I am a pervert. It’s not just because I’m bad with money. It’s not just because I’m adept at talking to girls either.

It’s because I am all of those things at once. Which, as I’m sure you don’t understand since you are weak, is essentially required to survive a place like a maid cafe — where cute girls prowl the room like lions.
We, my friend, are meant to be their meals. But tonight? Tonight, I will feast upon them. And I will show them what humans are truly capable of.
Oh god, there are two of them. I’m done for.
: Sensei! Hi! Welcome in!
: Not Sensei, Chika-chan! This precious prince goes only by “Master” within these sacred walls!
: Right! Of course!
: Thanks so much for coming, Master! We’ve been eagerly awaiting your arrival!
: That’s right, Chika-chan! And we’re super-duper excited to take extra good care of you today!
: I would like to place an order for takeout.
: Do we even do that here?
: I think Master is implying that he wants to take us home.
: Then yes! You may place your order right now! Free of charge! But why wait until you get home when you can have us right here in the maid cafe?!
: Because, Chika-chan, that is something that we in the business call “illegal.”
: It’s only illegal if you get caught! Right, Master?
: Right. I’ll be taking Chika as my entree and Uta as dessert.
: And what would you like as an appetizer, Master? Might I recommend our brand new blueberry banana brownie batter baumkuchen?
: That’s too many B’s. I’ll just take Osako.
: I think Osako-chan is off limits to everybody but precious princesses.
: Just put a mask on her and tell her I’m Wakana. It’ll be fine.
: Aah! Bad Master! You are bringing dark energy into a place of joy and love! Don’t force Uta-chan to cast her infamous death beam on you!
: Sen...Master! You’re gonna pick me, right?! Do I get to serve you today?! I do, right?! Right?! RIGHT?!?!?!
: Oh, Chika-chan. You sweet summer child. This master is Uta-chan’s number one customer. He chooses her without fail any time he has the option.
: And how could he not? Uta-chan is the ultimate male fantasy of course.
: I choose Chika.
: See? Without fail. Every-
: Yay! I knew it! I knew Master would choose me!
I’m sorry, Uta-chan...but this is for your own good.
: I MEAN...MASTER!!!!
: Don’t worry, Uta-chan! I’m sure you’d be his first pick if I wasn’t working! And if money’s the problem, I’ll split his bill with you as a special thanks for being so darn cute!
: You look really upset right now.
: Uta-chan is fine! Albeit mildly betrayed! But that’s okay because she’s going to make Master pay for it somehow!
: How?
: Yeah, how? I am also suddenly very intrigued.
: That’s for you to know and...wait, I said it wrong. That’s for Uta-chan to know and you to find out! Ha!
: You...sure you’re okay, Uta-chan?
: More than okay, Chika-chan. Because it just so happens that I have decided to dine with Master today! And you will be serving both of us!
: Yay! Double money!
: Uta-chan eats free.
: Boo! Single money!
: Well, I guess I didn’t have to wait long to figure out how you were going to make me pay.
: Oh, this is just the beginning. Uta-chan is going to make you pay for this transgression for years to come. You will regret this choice, Master. Mark my words.
: Uhhhh...
: Come on, Sen...Master! Let’s get you seated and taken care of!
: In the locker room!
: Bad, Chika-chan! Are you trying to turn this place into a blueberry banana brownie batter brothel?!
: Buuuuuut don’t you think this master deserves a little special treatment? Huuuuuuh?
Chika grabs my arm and all I can hope is that Uta’s anti-sexual contact forcefield is weak today.
: No touching! Bad! Bad, Chika-chan!
Ugh. It’s not. It’s just as annoyingly strong as always.
Regardless of the lack of hot locker room maid sex, I still do get to order and be treated like a prince.
But apparently, Chika is not yet trained in the art of the flavor beam, so it’s just a normal...huge omelet served to me by a cute girl.
Granted, it’s a cute girl who, just like in the bedroom, is eager and ready to do whatever I say.
And it brings me comfort knowing she would gladly suck me off beneath the table in uniform if only this was a blueberry banana brownie batter brothel.
: Is there anything else I can get for you, Master? Osako-chan’s oolong tea is to die for! And that bluebanberobthbaumukuchen
: Say it right! That was way too quiet and way too wrong!
: Baumkuchen! It’s good!
: Tch. Ami-chan was right. I guess that is too many B’s.
: Is she here tonight? Can you tell her I’m-
: Nope! No Ami here! Just Chika-chan! So it’s time for you to pay attention to her!
: Ahem. Chika-chan? You seem to have skipped my order. I would like one blueberry-
: One blueberry, coming right up!
: You better bring me more than one blueberry, woman! This type of service would be unacceptable if Uta-chan had a penis!
: If Uta-chan had a penis, I probably wouldn’t be her number one customer.
: Yeah well, you’re not anymore. You’ve been demoted. Uta-chan’s number one customer always picks Uta-chan.
: Can I make it up to you by marrying you instead?
: Fine. Ring please.
: I don’t have one on me.
: All talk like always. How predictable.
: You’re not, like...actually mad at me, are you?
: Noooooo...
: You totally are.
: Uta-chan is just jealous. That’s all. But she understands that Chika-chan can be unpredictable at times and is just going to hope that you’re only doing this so nobody gets hurt.
: That’s exactly it. She seems kind of...okay in here, though. Apart from all the begging and...probably preparing you a single blueberry thing.
: Yeah, she actually fits in great here. She’s number two right after me now. Like, the gap is still pretty substantial. But she definitely has her fans.
: Does she? I didn’t realize that many people would be into the whole maid gyaru archetype thing.
: Gyaru? No. Chika went with a different archetype.
: Did she? She didn’t seem to be putting on a character for me at all.
: Yeah, because it’s you. Just look at how she treats the other customers, though.
: C-C-C-Chika-chan!
: Hi! Do you need something?
: We...um...we were thinking about maybe...asking Uta-chan to...serve us...n...next time...
: Oh God...her eyes...here it comes...
: So you’re going to leave me all alone?...
: Mnh...
: You realize this is my job, right?...
: Should I just starve and die? Is that what you want? You want Chika-chan to die?!
: You’d never do that to me, right?! You love Chika-chan! Don’t you?! You love me, don’t you?! Tell me you love me! Say it! Say it, say it!
: W-We love you, Chika-chan! We love you!
: W-We were only kidding about...asking for someone else!
: Good! Because you don’t want to know what I would have done to you if you weren’t. Your parents wouldn’t even be able to recognize you.
: It’s all because I love you, though! And I can’t wait to stay together forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever and if you ever look at another girl I will cut you into pieces!
: Hahahah! Whoops! Just kidding!
: Never fucking joke with me like that again. Got it? Good. Die, you fucking pigs.
: Uhh...sorry about that. Chika-chan is-
: She called us pigs!
: She told us to die! Did you hear that?!
: Oh.
: Yeah. Apparently, a lot of girls are just really into that. Either that or they just fear for their lives. But any first-timer who’s ever been served by Chika has never asked for anyone else.
: Not like I’m gonna complain, though. If it works, it works. She’s clearly got a thing.
: Yeah...I think I like your style a little more. Fearing for my life doesn’t really do it for me most of the time.
: She’s okay though, right? Like...that’s not actually something we should be worried about her saying to customers.
: Master?
: Master, are you in danger? Blink once for yes and twice for no.
: How many more years until we can move to Nara together?
: D-Don’t make my heart hurt at work, dummy! Uta-chan needs to look presentable and I can already feel myself getting hot!
: Well, you better not be getting hot for my master, Uta-chan!
: One very special blueberry for a very special girl! Where would you like it? Shall I feed it to you myself?
: Ahem.
: Chika. You are fired.
: Should I just starve and die?...
: Is that what you want? You want Chika-chan to die?! Is that it, Uta?! HUH?!
: I just want dessert! Why can’t you treat me like Sensei?!
: His...name...is...MASTER! YOU WILL ADDRESS HIM AS SUCH OR I WILL TELL HIM ABOUT THE TIME YOU ALMOST KISSED AMI!
: The time you what?
: PHPHPHBHBHHBHAAAA!!!! NOTHING!!! SHE’S MAKING THAT UP, MASTER! UTA-CHAN ONLY HAS EYES FOR YOU!
: KEEP YOUR EYES OFF OF MY MASTER!!!!
: Um! C-Chika-chan! We’re ready for our b-
: WHEN DID I GIVE YOU PERMISSION TO SPEAK!?
: W-W-W-We’re sorry!!!!!!!
So yeah, I think it’s probably safe to say that Chika has gone off the deep end.
Which...was probably safe to say quite a while ago.
But there are moments every now and then where her true self peeks out again. And those are the moments I hope for every time I go out of my way to see her.
I still love her at the end of the day. And if I’m not able to do that just because she’s a little bit broken now, how am I supposed to expect anyone to ever love me?
This rings especially true when I remember I’m the one who cracked her in the first place. I just can’t really see any of the damage when she looks at me with eyes like those.
: I am so glad you came to see me at work today. It was nice getting to serve somebody I actually like for a change.
: Yeah...you seemed pretty harsh on those two girls back there.
: That’s because they look at me with eyes that only you should look at me with. The hungry kind. Like they want to devour me whole.
: And it would be fine if I devoured you then?
: You can devour me whenever you want. And I’m not just the entree, Sensei. I’m a full three-course meal.
: Well, you definitely look great in the uniform.
: And yet a certain someone still hasn’t gotten to experience what it’s like to take it off of me.
: One day, sure. Not tonight though, if that’s what you’re getting at.
: Why not? There’s a karaoke place on the way back to my apartment that I’ve heard basically no one ever monitors.
: Yeah...definitely not a karaoke place. I don’t have a good track record with those.
: I didn’t realize you’d...done stuff there with other girls.
: Chika, can we talk?
: Please don’t break up with me.
: ...What?
: Everyone’s telling me I’m going crazy. But I don’t feel crazy. So if you think I’m going crazy too, just...I don’t know. Please don’t break up with me, though. I’m really trying. Really.
: Who have you heard that from? That you’re going crazy. Yumi?
: Plus Rin. And the girls at the maid cafe. Hell, even Sana’s pointed it out and I barely even know her.
: Yeah, well...Sana’s not the most particularly sane person either, I don’t think.
: And it’s not just because I’m seeing love the way you do now, right? Like...there’s more to it than that. There has to be, right? Because no one calls you insane for thinking that way. Why me? Why-
: Chika...you really don’t need to try and adapt to my way of thinking if you’re struggling with it.
: No, I do. Because the alternative is me finding out you’ve been cheating on me with a million other people and...I don’t...
: I don’t think you understand what that would do to me, Sensei.
: So you’d rather I just...what? Keep you in the dark forever?

: I’d rather you love just me and only me. And I get that you don’t. I obviously get that. It just...fucking sucks. Like, I don’t even know who else you’ve been with. I feel so...ignored. And just...all around shitty.
: Yet, you’re desperate for me to not break up with you.
: Hurting with you beats hurting alone.
: You’re not alone, Chika. There are plenty of other people with more love to offer you than I can.
: Well, what if I took it all?
: What?...
: Would you be able to stay with me if I did the same thing you do? And love other people?
: It’s not my place to tell you what you can and can’t do.
: But it is your place to tell me how it would make you feel!

: I have given you everything. Not just my body and my heart, but my family. I have cried more tears for you at this point than I did for my fucking father when he walked out on me. That means something.
: So yeah. I am going to force myself to change if you need me to do that in order to live with the guilt that I know you have for hurting me. But I need you to give me something too. I deserve that.
: What do you want, Chika?...
: I can’t just stop being the way I am. If I could, I’d have done it already.
: I need you...to need me.
: It’s that simple.
: I can handle the love thing. I can make myself believe it. And...
: Maybe, I’ve...kind of...already started to.
: But there’s still this huge void in my chest that feels like it’s getting wider every single day, and you’re the one I want to fill it.
: Chika...why are you betting everything on the first person you’ve ever fallen for? A depraved and depressed teacher, no less. You’re so much smarter than this. Smarter than me.
: Words can’t explain it.
: You just have to believe me when I say it has to be you...or no one at all.
: I’m sorry for just...springing this on you. Things have been weird lately and it’s all just...coming out.
: No, it’s fine...this is what I wanted when I told you in the first place.
: You only told me at all because you had to or I was going to kill Yumi.
: Well, what do you want me to do now then? Give you every single detail? Weigh in on what I’d really do if you followed in my footsteps? How do I fix this?
: You’re not going to break up with me then?
: I don’t have the fucking balls to break up with anyone.
: And even if I did...you’re...
: Special...I guess.
: Mm.
: I’m winning...
: Can I ask you something?
: Sure. I can’t guarantee my answer won’t just make everything worse, though.
: If I was never in your class...and just some girl you met maybe five...ten years from now...
: Do you think you’d ask me for my number?
: ...I don’t get it.
: Me neither.
: I just want to know.
: I’m...not really sure. I think the...context would probably matter? Asking someone for their number out of nowhere is a little weird, isn’t it?
: Fair. I think I’d ask for yours before you even had a chance to anyway.
: Yeah well, your feelings for me are clearly stronger than mine since they’re only aimed at one person instead of everyone you’ve ever met. Of course you’d win out in that scenario.
: Assuming you don’t already have a boyfriend in this make believe world five or ten years from now.
: Who says I wouldn’t have a girlfriend instead?
: Your track record of sleeping with only men.
: And if I had a secret lesbian tryst behind your back? Would your opinion of me change at all?
: Yeah. I think you’d be way cooler.
: But I’d also never forgive you for not inviting me.
: Hahah! I’ll keep that in mind for next time.
: Next time?
: I’m a baaaaaad girl, Sensei! Really just following in your footsteps. Always horny and always open for business!
: Mhm. Right. So you just want me to think you’re cool.
: Maaaaaybe! I’ll just have to keep you in the dark, though. For your own good, of course.
: Is that what you want me to do then? Just...never bring this up again? Let you keep living your monogamous fantasy life where you’re always winning and always blissfully ignorant?
: Heheh...maaaaaybe.
: That’s a serious question, Chika. I want to avoid hurting you however I can. Just-
: Just without changing who you are.
: Leave the changing to me, Sensei...I’m young. I still can.
: I hate that I’m doing this to you.
: I think you love that you’re doing this to me. Otherwise, you’d go after girls your own age.
: Okay, maybe you are actually cool. That’s a level of sass I fully deserve.
: If you think I’m cool now, you should see me at karaoke.
: I already told you, no sex tonight.
: But there’s no better time to have sex than right after talking your feelings out! I wanna do it! Pleeeeeeease?
: Pleeeeeeeeease?
: Not tonight.
: I feel like this is a good place to leave things.
